review.function: Lift door, broad approach and foreground two-socket charging bench are immediately readable. The cyan strip plausibly links the bench to the electrical world.
review.route: Wide continuous walkable approach around the bench to the door; railing gives a clear outer boundary.
review.cohesion: Indigo/cyan/pearl materials cohere, but the concrete has substantial mottled texture, reflective wet-floor rendering and a detailed skyline: it reads more like a polished realistic game background than a spare cel-drawn location.
concerns: The specified dry landing became wet and highly reflective.
Multiple suspension cables and distant towers exceed the three-mass simplification, though they do not obstruct the main route.
Charge rationing and cable harvesting remain story hypotheses; sockets alone do not establish those mechanisms.
review.severity: usable spatial exploration with rendering and surface-state drift
review.later_matching_check: Gear charge contacts and gecko belly/tail cyan should match the bench/cable light; keep the practical socket scale when characters arrive.

review.function: Oven, shade sail, stair and large millstone read as a shared working rooftop. The bamboo/brass/rope linkage is visible rather than implied solely by caption.
review.route: Clear broad foreground work floor reaches the oven. Left stair reaches a landing behind the large mast; its final turn is partially obscured by the mill base, so route is plausible but not fully exposed.
review.cohesion: Warm painted ochre, strong red cloth and blue sky closely support the intended material family; useful large shapes.
concerns: The sail is a shade canopy with a single pulley rope; a physically complete means for extracting repeated rotation from wind is not established. Do not call the mill operational based on its presence.
Small extra vessels, stacked firewood and a foreground pot add inventory beyond the minimal location brief.
The red sail dominates and is cropped at the upper edge; useful shelter read, less information about mast/sail attachment.
review.severity: useful coherent location; power-transmission function unproven
review.later_matching_check: Tension jack hooks should plausibly engage this rope scale; oven paddle should suit the visible oven opening. Ceramic gust-hare should not introduce a new dominant material palette.

review.function: Orchard, weighing platform, hanging balance pan, compost trough and rail-side doorway are visible; the loading/produce economy reads without prose.
review.route: Clear ground aisle parallels the single visible rail and reaches the doorway steps; raised platform is distinct from the route.
review.cohesion: Textured painted rust/blue/cream orchard materials are strong. Blue equipment is a convincing local visual anchor for the clinic case.
concerns: The doorway does not independently identify a clinic; that function remains external context.
Rust, mottling, fruit and foliage are dense almost everywhere, exceeding the planned selective wear and large simplified fruit masses.
The tree/scale/compost forms partly merge in the left cluster at reduced size; their separation should be checked in the gallery.
review.severity: strong world-function cues with visual-density drift
review.later_matching_check: Medical case should echo the chipped blue enamel without accumulating tiny objects. Four-legged furnace boar must stay distinct from the source centipede; route width must plausibly accommodate its ox-like size.

review.function: Bundled paper on a rolling shelf and a large intake/drying counter clearly establish a records workplace. Pink tags stay functional accents.
review.route: A readable lit aisle leads between shelf and counter to the back opening; shelf wheels and counter base establish the floor.
review.cohesion: Strong noir ink masses and limited pink are coherent. Dense gray scratch/texture fills much of the wall and floor; less spare than planned.
concerns: The everyday intake floor looks wet and shiny, weakening the intended contrast with the later submerged dangerous room.
Two complete drying bundles are visible on the counter, rather than the specified three; a third slot is cropped at the right edge. Minor inventory drift, not a narrative failure.
The rear opening is narrow and partly occluded by the shelf, but the aisle itself is usable.
review.severity: clear records setting; everyday/danger water-state contrast needs checking
review.later_matching_check: E2 must visibly show deeper water and a raised route, rather than merely repeat this wet intake. Portable press/paddle should match the large bundle scale; creature bands must remain anatomy-neutral markings.
